name: trace_constraint_sympy_microfit
classification_note: Bounded symbolic microfit for the trace-one constraint on real 2x2 density candidates. It proves local Bloch and spectral 2x2 trace identities with sympy, uses z3 only as a supportive invalid-witness rejector, and does not treat tautological trace algebra as solver load-bearing work. It is not density-matrix admission, bridge, QIT, GStack, axis, engine, or nonclassical admission.
